name: VOD Catalog Manager
description: Non-core VOD catalog management for categories, naming rules, aliases and safe bulk changes.
author: justandroidtv

fields.label: Safety
fields.description: Core files are never edited. Writes are preview-first and audited.

actions.label: VOD Control Status
actions.description: Read-only VOD counts and plugin state.

actions.label: Regex Apply
actions.description: Apply a reviewed bounded regex batch.

actions.label: Regex Apply Async
actions.description: Run a large reviewed regex job through the Celery worker.

confirm.title: Queue VOD regex job?
confirm.message: The job may touch many VOD titles in bounded transactions.

actions.label: Job Status
actions.description: Read the state and progress of a background VOD job.

actions.label: Cancel Job
actions.description: Request cooperative cancellation of a queued/running VOD job.

confirm.title: Cancel background job?
confirm.message: Cancellation is cooperative and takes effect at a safe transaction boundary.

actions.label: Category Visibility
actions.description: Hide/show one category for one M3U account.

actions.label: Delete Empty Category
actions.description: Delete a category only when it has no content or account relations.

confirm.title: Delete empty category?
confirm.message: Backup first. Automatic recreation is not guaranteed.
